[P2] Approach: service classification lacks the test required by rule 4

Removing this catch would send service exceptions through the new retryable fallback, yet both existing `CheckpointManagerTest` service-error tests would still pass: they assert only the exception class. The classifier tests call `DurableApiErrorClassifier` directly, so they cannot detect this wiring regression either. Consequently, KMS errors could become retryable without failing a test. Rule 4 requires a test that fails without each branch. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and establish coverage that distinguishes terminal service errors from retryable client failures.
